next.reason: 1985: "The range of the output procedure must not cause the execution of any MERGE, RELEASE, or SORT statement."; 2023: "causes the execution of any MERGE, RELEASE, or format 1 SORT statement, the EC-SORT-MERGE-ACTIVE exception condition is set to exist". 1985 simply prohibits it. 2023 restricts the ban to format 1 (file) SORT, so a table SORT is allowed, and a violation now sets EC-SORT-MERGE-ACTIVE with undefined results.
